sourceTitle: An Apology for the Colouring of the Greek Court in the Crystal Palace
description: "An Apology for the Colouring of the Greek Court in the Crystal Palace" by Owen Jones is an artistic exploration published in the mid-19th century, specifically during the Victorian era. The book presents a detailed argument for the polychromy of Greek architecture, asserting that ancient Greek monuments were originally bright and colorful rather than the stark white they appear today.
